reasons: CS3233, ST2334, CS3264, CS3268 and IS1108 are all open to BComp CS Hons, none is completed or blocked by a completed course, and their prerequisites are satisfied by completed courses (CS3233: CS2030S and CS2040S; ST2334: MA1521) or can be satisfied by planned ST2334 (CS3264, CS3268).
The must-wishes contradict each other: 'CS3264 must come before ST2334' and 'ST2334 must come before CS3264' cannot both hold in any plan.

The prerequisite structure also forces ST2334 first: CS3264 requires ST2334 (or a mutually exclusive alternative such as ST2131/MA2116/EE2012, which would block the required ST2334), and CS3268 requires ST2334 strictly earlier and is offered only in Sem 1 (semester 7), so ST2334 must be in semester 6, before CS3264. The wish 'CS3264 before ST2334' is therefore impossible.
plan.note: Ignoring the impossible wish, the earliest-graduation schedule would be Sem 6: ST2334, CS3233; Sem 7: CS3268, CS3264; Sem 8: IS1108.
